description:
A team workspace for running AI coding agents in parallel with isolated Git worktrees, live diff review, GitHub integration, and mobile access.

Lody is a team agent workspace: share coding agents with your team on phone and desktop. Shared sessions, live diffs, and one control plane keep your team and agents in sync.
Run agents in parallel with isolated Git worktrees and live diff review, use subscriptions you already have with Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Kimi, and any agent that speaks ACP, manage the same control plane in the terminal with CLI commands, and ship together in one workspace with shared sessions, usage by member, and PR, CI, and merge status in-session.
Version 0.90.1
✨ New
- Added Zen layout mode for a more focused workspace experience (#341).
- Upgraded macOS auto-updates with incremental updates, native progress reporting, and more reliable installation verification (#173).
- Added session renaming tools (#337).
- Added support for custom DeepSeek Harness service endpoints (#293).
- Improved Agent and Provider settings with clearer configuration, status, and unavailability details (#257).
🐛 Fixes and Improvements
- Improved CLI daemon startup recovery, status diagnostics, and error messages (#287).
- Fixed Agent capability refresh failures and configuration state inconsistencies across multi-turn operations.
- Improved Markdown links, bold URLs, CJK input methods, and mention input behavior (#274, #309, #294).
- Improved session tabs, plan approval, settings navigation, and compact mobile layouts (#326, #315, #334, #285).
- Improved local project folder selection, SVG file attachments, and desktop Cmd+W behavior (#291, #173).
- Fixed the built-in browser failing to connect in some proxied network environments (#299).
- Improved Codex goal command control and child-session workspace guidance (#144, #225).
- Thanks to external contributors @jeffwcx, @EYHN, @Innei, @MichaelYuhe, @sinxy-sai, @natsustan, @slashdevcorpse, and @ImSingee.
